transcript: So I ranked the modern green utopia as my most preferred because it focuses more on sustainability, environmental protection, and I guess long-term security. And those are important to me because they, I guess, balance human needs while also protecting natural resources for future generations. And I guess I rate the others in between because I like the connection to nature and small-scale living. and the moral commonwealth, the futurist utopia, institutional utopia, and religious utopia are all in the middle because I like their positive qualities, but they also have limitations. So I ranked the AI-centered utopia last because I'm uncomfortable with societies that rely heavily on data-driven governances. And I don't think artificial intelligence shouldn't be making such important decisions. I believe human judgment, ethics, and individual freedoms should remain central to how societies are governed.
